description:
The testing guide names the redo-record benchmark harness as its publication-cost evidence, and the journal-shaped harness it replaces stops shipping.

## Background

The guide pins publication-cost numbers to an artifact produced by a nine-hundred-line script written around the journal's shape: it asserts the presence and absence of an external bootstrap control directory and counts directory fsync calls, a property of the journal's phase barriers. Both the numbers and the named evidence contract go stale on the first day of the change.

The guide also maintains a per-test cost attribution table naming tests that this work retires or renames, and a build-budget note derived from measured worst-case figures. The suite profile artifact, pinned at four thousand four hundred and eighty-one tests, goes stale when a large block of tests disappears.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The guide's publication-cost evidence names the redo-record benchmark harness and its committed artifact.
- [hard] REQ-02: The journal-shaped benchmark script stops shipping, and contracts reference it nowhere.
- [hard] REQ-03: The per-test cost attribution table names only tests that exist.
- [hard] REQ-04: The build-budget note states figures re-derived after the change, holding or tightening.
- [hard] REQ-05: The suite-timing evidence artifact is refreshed, or its staleness is recorded with the test count it was pinned at and the condition for refreshing it.
- [hard] REQ-06: The guide's description of a storage round trip states the redo record.
- [hard] REQ-07: The change removes more lines than it adds.
title: Testing guide publication-cost evidence
